Quick note: we have a time-sensitive cash-application need tied to a downstream vendor cutoff that will impact Velotech's access to a prioritized support window if settlement doesn't land today. Invoice 2026-721 (attached) is currently outstanding. Can you confirm payment within the next hour?

Apologies for the brief delay — pinging internal teams now.

Danielle — thanks for the quick reply. Two items from our side:

1) W-9: attached is a signed W-9 (w9_redwood_signed.pdf) showing the exact legal payee name "Redwood Inference, Inc." — that should satisfy bank validation.
2) Card fee handling: to keep things simple for this urgent window, Redwood will absorb up to 1.5% of card processing fees for this single transaction if Velotech chooses virtual card today. Any fee above that will be passed through — we can provide the exact expected fee amount once we know the processor token.

Operational plan (recommended):
- If ACH can be initiated within the hour, great — confirm and we'll watch for the trace.
- If ACH is not possible, reply "VIRTUAL-CARD OK" and we'll generate a token and send secure payment instructions (10 minutes).
- If card is blocked, we'll provide wire details; please advise the latest practical wire cutoff for your bank so we can escalate on our side.

I've CC'd Marissa (billing ops) to stand up the virtual card token quickly if you approve.
